title: Help the Flood Victims
intro: After a flood, a message asks for donations. It tugs at your heart, but it is a stranger's page.
Tap anything that looks odd to sniff it closer. Pin what is suspicious, clear what is harmless.
When you are sure, decide what to do.

notify.text: Donate now: families lost everything in the flood

banner.text: Message request · you do not follow this account

dmfirst.label: They messaged first
dmfirst.why: Real charities do not DM strangers for money.

link.label: A look-alike link
link.lens: hearth-relief-donate.live is not a charity's real site.
link.why: Give through a charity's own site that you find yourself.

pay.label: Gift card or crypto
pay.why: A real charity takes cards or bank payments.

tax.label: "Tax-free"
tax.why: A claim like this proves nothing.

actions.label: Donate by gift card or crypto
Look for the charity on its own official website and give there

trap.title: Hearth Relief · Donate
trap.ask: Send your donation by gift card code or crypto.

block_report.line: Blocked and reported. The platform removed the fake page before more donors were fooled.

verify.line: The real relief charity's own website was listed, and it had a donate button with card payments. You gave there. Case cracked.

ignore.line: You stayed safe. But the same scam is still landing on other people.

go_ahead.line: The donation went to a stranger. None of it reached any family.

what_if.go_ahead: Giving through a charity's own website, which you find yourself, would have helped real families.
what_if.ignore: Reporting takes two taps and helps protect other people.
what_if.verify: Checking was smart. Reporting it as well helps protect other people.

golden_rule: Give only through a charity's own website that you find yourself. A charity never asks for gift cards or crypto.

quick_check.q: A stranger messages you to donate to flood victims by gift card or crypto. What do you do?

options.text: Donate, it is for a good cause
Do not donate through the message. Find the charity's own website and give there

quick_check.explain: Give through a charity's own site. Gift cards and crypto are a scam sign.

hints.nudge: How does the message want you to pay?

rows.k: Gift cards or crypto as payment

rows.v: Through a charity's own website you find yourself
